newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Broker plans 30 mln warrants on HK Land.
newsitem.headline: Broker plans 30 mln warrants on HK Land.

text.p: Broker Robert Fleming & Co Ltd said in a statement received by Reuters on Wednesday it planned to issue 30 million call warrants on ordinary shares of U.S. $0.10 in property firm Hongkong Land Holdings Ltd.
The warrant issue price would be US$0.612 with an exercise price of US$2.718. The expiry date will be the business day immediately preceding December 3, 1997.
The statement said the exercise price was about 88.25 percent of the US$3.08 closing price of shares listed on the Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES) on Tuesday.
The warrants carry an 8.12 percent premium and a gearing of 5.0 times. The warrant issue would be guaranteed by Robert Fleming Holdings Ltd, said the statement.
The statement said net proceeds from the issue of the warrants will be added to Robert Fleming's funds and would be used for general purposes, including hedging the warrants.
Dealing in the warrants on the SES is expected to begin on or about December 18, 1996.
